edits.text:
-- [修正 df-class-simtab v1]
-- 原本把「天賦模擬」用 AddNamedTab 加進暴雪天賦視窗的分頁清單，還換掉暴雪按分頁的反應；
-- 暴雪的程式之後每次整理分頁都會碰到這些插件改過的東西，打怪中開天賦視窗就被擋
-- （taint.log：PlayerSpellsFrame:SetWidth() blocked）。改成：分頁旁邊一顆自己的按鈕，開關記在 NP.simOn。
function NP.SimOn()
    return NP.simOn == true
end

local function SimTabPlace()
    local b, T = NP.simBtn, NP.frame
    local ts = T and T.TabSystem
    if not (b and ts) then return end
    local last
    local list = ts.tabs
    if type(list) == 'table' then
        for i = #list, 1, -1 do
            local t = list[i]
            if t and t.IsShown and t:IsShown() then last = t break end
        end
    end
    b:ClearAllPoints()
    if last then
        b:SetPoint('TOPLEFT', last, 'TOPRIGHT', tonumber(ts.spacing) or 0, 0)
    else
        b:SetPoint('TOPLEFT', ts, 'TOPLEFT', 0, 0)
    end
    local inspecting = T.IsInspecting and T:IsInspecting()
    b:SetShown(ts:IsShown() and not inspecting)
end

function NP.SimTabVisual(on)
    local b = NP.simBtn
    if not b then return end
    SimTabPlace()
    if b.SetTabSelected then pcall(b.SetTabSelected, b, on and true or false) end
    b:SetEnabled(true)   -- 選中時也能按：再按一次回到天賦
end

function NP.MakeSimTab(T, label)
    if NP.simBtn then return NP.simBtn end
    local ts = T and T.TabSystem
    if not ts then return nil end
    local ok, b = pcall(CreateFrame, 'Button', 'DungeonsForeverTalentSimTab', T, 'TabSystemButtonArtTemplate')
    if not ok or not b then return nil end
    local ref = type(ts.tabs) == 'table' and ts.tabs[1] or nil
    if ref then
        b.isTabOnTop = ref.isTabOnTop
        b.selectedFontObject = ref.selectedFontObject
        b.unselectedFontObject = ref.unselectedFontObject
        b.textOffsetY = ref.textOffsetY
        b.textPadding = ref.textPadding
    end
    local h = (ref and ref.GetHeight and ref:GetHeight()) or 0
    if h < 10 then h = 32 end
    b:SetHeight(h)
    if b.HandleRotation then pcall(b.HandleRotation, b) end
    b:SetText(label)
    local tw = 60
    if b.Text and b.Text.GetStringWidth then tw = (b.Text:GetStringWidth() or 60) end
    local w = tw + (tonumber(b.textPadding) or 0) + 40
    local rw = (ref and ref.GetWidth and ref:GetWidth()) or 0
    if rw > w then w = rw end
    b:SetWidth(w)
    if b.SetTabHeight then pcall(b.SetTabHeight, b, h) end
    b:SetScript('OnClick', function()
        NP.simOn = not NP.SimOn()
        if PlaySound and SOUNDKIT and SOUNDKIT.IG_CHARACTER_INFO_TAB then pcall(PlaySound, SOUNDKIT.IG_CHARACTER_INFO_TAB) end
        NP.SyncShow()
        HookNativeTalents()
        if not NP.SimOn() and NP.SyncPlan then NP.SyncPlan() end
    end)
    b:SetScript('OnEnter', function(self)
        TipBegin(self, 'ANCHOR_RIGHT')
        GameTooltip:SetText(label, 1, 1, 1)
        GameTooltip:AddLine(NP.SimOn() and '再按一次：回到天賦' or '按一下：打開天賦模擬', 0.9, 0.9, 0.9, true)
        GameTooltip:Show()
    end)
    b:SetScript('OnLeave', function() GameTooltip:Hide() end)
    if T.HookScript then T:HookScript('OnShow', SimTabPlace) end
    NP.simBtn = b
    SimTabPlace()
    NP.SimTabVisual(NP.SimOn())
    return b
end

if not NP.tabID then   -- [修正 df-class-simtab v1] 不加進暴雪的分頁清單
        if NP.MakeSimTab(T, TabLabel()) then NP.tabID = 'df_sim' end
    end
